blind.description: A set of stylized wooden stairs consisting of five steps enclosed by solid side banisters/railings and vertical wood planking on the sides and back. The structure features rounded timber handrails with circular bolt or peg details along the framing. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and painted in a hand-painted stylized warm brown wood texture with soft highlights. It stands flat on the ground with no plinth, unattached parts, or floating elements.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a rectangular frame enclosing five horizontal wood plank steps/treads, flanked by thick timber borders on the left and right and vertical planks at the top edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.5 to 0.6 times as tall as the scale figure (roughly 3 to 3.5 ft tall) and about 2.5 to 3 ft wide.
